    • chatLine

      net.kyori.adventure.text.Component chatLine(org.bukkit.entity.Player player, net.kyori.adventure.text.Component message)
      Renders a message as the public chat line of a player. The line uses the configured chat.format, the prefix of the player, and the display name of the player. The prefix includes the PlayerPrefixEvent prefixes for PlayerPrefixEvent.Target.CHAT. Plex calls that event synchronously from this method. This method does not send the line. Call it on a thread that can read the player, such as the command thread of that player.
      Parameters:
      player - player who is the source of the line
      message - message body, already formatted
      Returns:
      the chat line

    • captureActionBroadcast

      ActionBroadcast captureActionBroadcast(org.bukkit.command.CommandSender sender)
      Captures recipient policy for an administrative action on the sender's command thread, before starting asynchronous work or scheduling work on another entity or region. A vanished player's announcements go only to that player, console, and online players the active SuperVanish/PremiumVanish integration allows to see them at capture time. Later joins, disconnects, or visibility changes do not expand or refresh that audience. Non-player senders and nonvanished players retain ordinary public broadcast behavior. Without a supported vanish plugin, announcements are public.
      Parameters:
      sender - player or non-player performing the action
      Returns:
      reusable announcement delivery for this action, not for subsequent invocations
